svg.text: 3. Design Class Diagram — UC11 Ask a question in natural language
HOW the domain model is realised: layered View / Controller / Service / Repository / Interface structure. Yellow tags mark the pattern each element applies.
realised by all five node functions
Strategy: one service = one interchangeable step
wraps every tool call with timing + structured logging
view -> controller -> application -> domain service -> repository -> infrastructure; each layer only knows the one below.
ChatPage is the view, useStreamChat the view-model holding ChatMessage state, streamChat() the transport gateway.
run_sql is the only way into the technology tables; callers pass a QueryParams, never SQL or a Session.
get_chat_model() / PROVIDER_REGISTRY -- adding a provider is one dict entry, zero call-site changes.
BaseChatModel has 6 interchangeable adapters; NodeFn has 5 interchangeable pipeline services.
AgentState is the shared workspace; route_after_* are the transition guards on conditional edges.
planner -> sql_gen -> interpreter -> visualizer, with a bounded retry edge back to the planner.
QueryParams is a validated command; the LLM fills fields instead of writing SQL (injection-safe by construction).
astream_events -> SSE events -> frontend callbacks: one event stream, three subscriber layers.
@tool and @with_observability add schema binding and timing/logging without touching tool logic.
get_graph() caches the compiled graph; chat.py fronts the whole pipeline; _build_echarts_spec / _build_query assemble.
